$comment: Slice-1 mirror of the @hues theme.seeds.json directory theme (see SWAP.md). Every sys slot resolves to the value seeds actually renders: live values ported as-is, except sys.color.bg which takes the warmed ground per Dustin's Q3 ruling — the conversion's only deliberate color delta. The six near-miss design defaults (seeds-link, fern, seeds-deep, seeds-muted, gold-ink, ink-soft) are NOT taken; each note records why, because a silent swap to any of them would be an undeclared re-derivation of the directory's identity.

sys.color.bg.note: Q3 DELTA (Dustin 2026-11-23): warmed ground replaces live paper #f8f1e1 as the ground. PWA theme-color follows this value.

sys.color.link.note: As-is. Design default design.seeds-link #1B5E37 not taken (near-miss; seeds' identity value stands).

sys.color.accent.note: As-is. Seeds leaf-600 (hover/secondary green) occupies the accent slot; design default design.fern #2D6A4F not taken.

sys.color.accent-strong.note: As-is. Seeds leaf (primary green) occupies the accent-strong slot; design default design.seeds-deep #1B4332 not taken.

sys.color.text-muted.note: As-is. Design default design.seeds-muted #595959 not taken (near-miss; seeds' identity value stands).

sys.color.accent-ink.note: As-is. Seeds warn (ochre text: Unknown badges, field errors) occupies the accent-ink slot by role; design default design.gold-ink #86691f not taken.

sys.color.border-field.note: Design default kept AND unreferenced: no seeds token feeds this slot in slice 1 — seeds resting field borders render sys.color.border-strong (line-strong) and filled borders sys.color.text-soft (ink-soft), both as-is. Adopting #71806c on any seeds surface would be a second color delta, so the comp layer points fields at the as-is slots instead. Flagged for Quinn/design review.
